module: Internal tool for automatic ESC measurement/calibration (drivingDynamics/CMU controller), driven from the GE by util_calibrateESC. A worker coroutine runs a skew stiffness test by sweeping speeds (30 to 150 km/h, 2 m/s steps) and steering angles (0.5° to 20°), then writes the result to vehicles/<model>/drivingDynamics/<config>.stat.json. A second test (STM, yaw measurements at 200 km/h) exists but is disabled in performTests.
notes: performTests(vehicleName, configName) creates a coroutine resumed at each updateGFX; at its end (Testend state) it writes the files, stops the test, then the VM calls util_calibrateESC.vehicleDone() (killswitch) on the GE side. updateGFX also sends util_calibrateESC.heartbeat() every frame (watchdog).
Requires exactly one 'drivingDynamics/CMU' controller; otherwise error log and Testend state.

States: Idling, Initialization (measures the maximum wheel angle by steering fully 2 x 2 s), Settling (internal regulator toward the target speed, smoothed steering), Measuring (average over 100 front/rear stiffness measurements), Finished, Testend.
The internal speed regulator (updateCC) writes electrics.values.throttleOverride, limits lateral acceleration to about 1.6 g and imposes setAggressionOverride(1) on the vehicleController.
Output: skewStiffnessFront/Rear rounded down to the thousand (N/rad, inferred from code) in the .stat.json; STMMeasurements.csv (speed, wheel angle, average yaw) if STM measurements exist.
During the test, be:setPhysicsSpeedFactor(2) is requested from the GE; reset to 0 at the end.
Anomaly: startSkewStiffnessTest registers M.updateFixedStepCallback via M.*; if the module is reloaded, the reference may change. The STM test (startSTMMeasurementsTest) is not exported.
Anomaly: in stopSkewStiffnessTest, setState(finishedState) no longer produces file output; the writing is done by combineTestData called earlier in the coroutine.

onInit.desc: Initialization hook: resets state, counters, measurements and physics speed to zero (Idling state).

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: resumes the worker coroutine, sends the heartbeat to the GE and triggers the killswitch when it is finished.

startSkewStiffnessTest.desc: Starts the skew stiffness test: gets the CMU, registers the fixed-step callback, disables the ESC systems for calibration and switches to Initialization.

stopSkewStiffnessTest.desc: Stops the test: cuts the internal regulator, restores normal physics speed, Finished state.

performTests.desc: Launches the complete calibration sequence in a coroutine and stores model/config for the output file name.

updateFixedStepCallback.desc: Callback called by the CMU at a fixed physics step: runs the skew stiffness test logic.

updateGFXCallback.desc: GFX callback of the CMU; empty.
